title: a propagation as a nullish right operand stays where it was written: the conditionally evaluated operand compiles
notes: Flipped from a VIBE1204 refusal certification on 2026-09-05, when the reference's delimiter lowering retired the last three (SA-1) residues — exactly the retirement condition the previous expectation's own notes named. The program is unchanged: `maybe` is undefined when the harness calls main(), so the right operand IS evaluated, the propagation succeeds, and the printed name is the evidence that the operand ran exactly once, where it was written. The refusal history and its measurements are recorded at COVERAGE.md §4.15 and in the (SA-1) note.
